exposure: Implementation of relevant countermeasures to improve healthcare services
outcome: Proportion of women with more than 5 times of prenatal examination
Rate of three times of follow-up or more after delivery
cohort: The study included 892 pregnant and puerperal women in a control group (Oct 2017 - Jun 2019) and 843 rural pregnant and puerperal women in an observation group (Dec 2019 - Aug 2020) from Luzhou area.
finding: Targeted measures improved perinatal healthcare indexes, including prenatal examination coverage and postpartum follow-up rates, in the observation group compared to the control group.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of delivery in hospital or cesarean section rate between the two study periods.
